build_multimodal_processor: build a BaseMultiModalProcessor subclass to process multi-modal inputs for a vLLM model
create_prompt_insertion: create a PromptInsertion to insert placeholder tokens into a prompt at a specified target location
create_prompt_replacement: create a PromptReplacement to replace prompt tokens with multi-modal feature placeholder tokens
apply_prompt_updates: apply multi-modal prompt updates to a token sequence, inserting or replacing placeholder tokens
find_mm_placeholders: find multi-modal placeholder feature ranges within a processed token sequence
